en.topic_title: No contaminants found in ‘Scream’ drinks after school sports day tampering scare, police say
en.topic_summary:
No foreign substances have been found in sports drinks that sparked a tampering scare at a secondary school’s athletics meet, police have said, after videos of liquid squirting out of the sides of the bottles were widely circulated on social media.





Liquid appearing to spurt out the side of a bottle of “Scream.” Photo: Threads.
